announcements.headline: Kodal to explore Asamankese Lithium Project Ghana
announcements.insight: Expands Kodal's Ghanaian footprint beyond the established Ayawasa project, diversifying its resource base in a key African jurisdiction and signaling continued exploration momentum despite broader junior mining liquidity constraints.
